rules.message: business.gstin must be 15 characters like 29AAEPB4172K1ZB (capitals), or empty when not registered
seller_state must be a two-digit GST state code, 01 to 38 or 97 (29 is Karnataka)
number_prefix must be 1 to 6 letters or digits ("/" allowed after the first), with no spaces, dashes or other marks (a trailing dash or space is dropped)
